props.label: When Should Businesses Lodge a BAS?
props.html:
When Should Businesses Lodge a BAS?

The ATO requires businesses to lodge a BAS either monthly or quarterly, depending on their turnover. Large companies with an annual revenue above $20 million must lodge monthly, while smaller businesses typically report quarterly. Meeting these deadlines is essential to avoid fines and ensure smooth tax compliance.

Ideal Business Group provides timely BAS lodgement services, ensuring your reports are submitted within ATO deadlines. We keep track of lodgement dates, preventing last-minute issues and helping businesses stay organised. With our support, you can focus on business growth while we handle your tax obligations.

With Ideal Business Group, you can focus on growing your business while we handle tax compliance and lodgement complexities.

?What Is the Process of BAS Lodgements?

The BAS lodgement process begins with reviewing your financial records and reconciling all transactions for the reporting period. We then calculate your GST obligations, PAYG withholding, and any other reportable amounts. After thorough verification, we prepare and lodge your BAS directly with the Australian Taxation Office. Throughout the process, we keep you informed and ensure all figures are accurate before submission.

?When Can BAS Lodgements Be Done for Customers?

BAS lodgements are due monthly or quarterly, depending on the size of your business and ATO requirements. Quarterly BAS is generally due 28 days after the end of each quarter, while monthly BAS is due 21 days after the end of each month. If your business is managed by a registered tax agent like Ideal Business Group, you may qualify for extended lodgement dates. We help ensure your BAS is always lodged on time to avoid late penalties.

props.label: Need quick answers? Ask us directly.
props.html:
Frequently Asked Questions

Need quick answers? Ask us directly.

What is a BAS lodgement?
A BAS lodgement is a report submitted to the ATO detailing GST, PAYG withholding, and other tax obligations.
Who needs to lodge a BAS?
Businesses registered for GST in Australia are required to lodge a BAS.
How often do I need to lodge a BAS?
Businesses must lodge a BAS either monthly or quarterly, depending on their turnover.
What happens if I miss a BAS deadline?
Late BAS lodgements can result in penalties, interest charges, and ATO compliance issues.
Can I lodge a BAS myself?
Yes, but professional assistance ensures accuracy, compliance, and minimises the risk of errors.
How does Ideal Business Group help with BAS lodgements?
We review, prepare, and submit BAS statements, ensuring compliance and timely lodgement.
What information is required for a BAS?
Sales, expenses, GST collected, and PAYG withholding details must be included in a BAS.
Are there penalties for incorrect BAS lodgements?
Yes, incorrect submissions can lead to fines, audits, and additional tax liabilities.
Can I amend a BAS after submission?
Yes, businesses can correct errors by submitting a BAS amendment to the ATO.
How can I ensure my BAS is correct?
Using a professional service like Ideal Business Group ensures accuracy and compliance with ATO requirements.
